selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Message replay / missing consumed-message guard: withdrawTokens has no explicit already-processed check; replay defense fully delegated to _consumeMessageStarknet/Starknet core. If not atomically marked consumed, same request re-runs loop: escrowed tokens re-released (double-spend), non-escrowed re-minted.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Permissionless — any caller with a valid/replayed Starknet message payload.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: observe consumed L2->L1 withdrawal -> call withdrawTokens(request) again -> _consumeMessageStarknet does not revert -> loop re-releases escrow / re-mints to ownerL1.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol/escrow (double-released tokens; supply inflated); legitimate L1 owners.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: req.ownerL1 receives duplicate NFTs / double-withdrawn escrow.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: No explicit consumed-message check in this function; guard delegated to external Starknet core whose behavior not visible; affects escrow accounting + ERC-721 supply; cannot reject without proving atomic consume; potentially High/Critical.
